title: NisurgCare Wellness Reference
purpose: Plain-language reference material for non-diagnostic, resident-specific wellness check-ins. It is not a clinical decision tool.

references.note: For adults, a normal reading is below 120/80 mm Hg; individual goals can differ.
For most adults who are calm and at rest, 60–100 beats per minute is a common reference range.

references.source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
references.note: For adults age 65 and older, 7–8 hours is a general daily reference.
A fasting blood-glucose reference of 70–99 mg/dL does not apply to random or post-meal readings; an individual care plan controls.

guidance.higher_consistency: Your recent routine information is broadly close to your own baseline. Continue the routines that support your comfort, rest, and regular movement.
guidance.medium_consistency: A few recent routine signals are less consistent with your usual pattern. Consider noting how you feel and sharing a persistent change with your care team.
guidance.lower_consistency: Several recent routine signals differ from your usual pattern. A care-team check-in can help decide whether the change is temporary or needs follow-up.
guidance.sleep_below_reference: Your recent sleep is below the general 7–8 hour reference for many adults age 65+. Sleep needs vary, so compare it with your usual pattern and care plan.
guidance.resting_pulse_outside_reference: Your displayed resting pulse differs from the common 60–100 bpm adult reference. Medicines, activity, and individual health needs can affect pulse; use your personal care plan as the guide.
guidance.blood_pressure_context: Blood-pressure numbers are shown for context only. Individual targets differ, and one reading alone should not be interpreted without a qualified care professional.
guidance.glucose_context: Glucose readings depend on timing, meals, medicines, and an individual care plan. The general fasting reference does not classify a random reading.
guidance.movement_context: Movement is compared with your own recent routine, not with a universal target. Comfort, mobility needs, and clinician guidance matter.

fasting_glucose_mg_dl.label: 70–99 mg/dL
fasting_glucose_mg_dl.important: Applies only to fasting blood-glucose tests.

safety: This information supports conversation and human review. It does not diagnose, prescribe, determine urgency, or replace a qualified clinician or emergency service.
